label: Proved-pool retrieval gaps on God-existence and attribute routes
summary: At 1c9e6607bc6e004abc94cdb41426dbd26d4a0e97, under the shared heavy-job lock, ran truth discover with the proved pool, a ranked cap of eight (plus eligible registered bridges), 3000 CLI heartbeats, batch four and two jobs. Duper searched the unfolded propositions. Lean-auto used Zipperposition for premise selection with Duper reconstruction. All seven targets had Lean declarations in the built library. Retrieval found no proved-pool candidate sharing the required vocabulary and a compatible binder anchor. These targets did not reach Duper. The four mixed-token priority targets use the selected Sum B E relation. Atom population, actual assertion, and operation agency also failed the retrieval gate.
blocker: Supply an explicit same-domain premise bundle if an existing proved proposition bears on the target. For a genuine witness or framework input, continue its independent research rather than treating the absence of a candidate as proof failure.
